infrastructure.statement: For high-risk remote onboarding, separate device delivery and directory-account creation from permission to reach applications. Before the new device can enroll the factor needed for application access, perform a reviewable identity-continuity check tied to the approved hire; rejected or inconclusive results should notify accountable teams and support appeal rather than automatically establishing fraud.
infrastructure.ordered_boundary: Managed-device possession and directory-account creation do not by themselves authorize application access; keep applications unavailable until a reviewable identity-continuity step succeeds or an accountable human exception is documented.

statements: Cloudflare says its Access policy evaluates the external identity result before protected email, code repositories, or other internal applications are reached.
The same page describes risk-triggered application revocation as currently available and in-session step-up verification as a future capability.
limitations: This is same-product-family implementation provenance from Cloudflare for the Cloudflare–Nametag integration, not independent effectiveness evidence or a customer outcome.
Do not infer that the source validates marketing claims, data-governance claims, error rates, or any automatic employment or threat-attribution decision.
